name: TacticalMapState
description: Canonical 2D map projection shared with tactical clients.

fields.format: TTT resource format identifier; map sidecars use TacticalTableTop.Map. Legacy sidecars may omit this field.
fields.imagePath: Map image path relative to the map asset directory.

grid.eastWestSquareCount: Number of squares from west to east.
grid.northSouthSquareCount: Number of squares from north to south.
grid.squareSizeFt: Physical size of each grid square in feet.
grid.boundaryBehavior: Optional map boundary mode: bounded maps restrict token placement to the image bounds without implying wall features; infinite maps allow placement beyond the image edge.

coordinateConvention.origin: Map corner from which positive coordinates increase inward.

fields.blockedTiles: Array of blocked square points with integer x and y coordinates.
fields.terrain: Terrain type defaults and rectangular overrides, including impassible squares that cannot be entered.
fields.elevation: Default elevation and rectangular elevation overrides.
fields.edges: Optional lattice-edge features. Each record has axis (vertical or horizontal), x, y, type (wall, doorway, door, secretDoor, or window), and optional widthFt, initialState, and locked fields. Coordinates use a southwest origin; widthFt applies to doorway, door, and window openings; doors and windows require a positive widthFt. Door initialState is open or closed, with locked true representing Closed and Locked. Secret doors are disclosed only in referee map responses; player responses serialize them as walls. Windows require initialState: uninspected (no visibility through, impassable), inspected (visibility through, impassable), or open (visibility through, passable). These window semantics are authored metadata; tactical visibility, movement enforcement, and state transitions are not implemented by the authoring feature.
fields.playerPlacement: Optional map-default inclusive player starting bounds: west, east, south, and north grid coordinates.
fields.stickers: Optional decorative emoji stickers. Each sticker has integer x and y square coordinates, an emoji string, sizePercent from 33 to 500, and optional opacityPercent from 0 to 100 (defaults to 100 for legacy stickers). Sticker opacity is independent of tactical indicator opacity. Stickers are visual-only and do not affect terrain or movement.
fields.mapPresentation: Renderer-facing map appearance settings, including optional blankBackgroundColor (#RRGGBB) metadata for author-created solid-color map images.
